MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Kiswahili word is like Mandarin 妈妈 māma? (1 mark)
   A. mama
   B. kaka
   C. shule
   D. dada

2. What does 六 (liù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Six
   B. Eight
   C. Seven
   D. Ten

3. What does 三 (sān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Six
   C. Three
   D. One

4. What does 水果 (shuǐguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. What
   B. Fruit (as a group)
   C. Drinks
   D. Milk

5. What does 咖啡 (kāfēi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Lunch
   B. Coffee
   C. Dinner
   D. To eat

6. What does 眼睛看 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The mouth speaks
   B. The eyes see
   C. The hands write
   D. The ears hear

7. What is a good safety tip in strong rain? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore warnings
   B. Shelter under a tall tree in a storm
   C. Play near the river
   D. Stay away from fast rivers

8. What is the full stop in Chinese? (1 mark)
   A. 。
   B. ,
   C. 、
   D. ?

9. Which sentence means "Thank you!"? (1 mark)
   A. 你呢?
   B. 谢谢!
   C. 我叫小明。
   D. 老师好!

10. What does 姐姐 (jiějie) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Older sister
   C. Mother
   D. To have, there is

11. Which word is pronounced xīngqītiān? (1 mark)
   A. 七
   B. 星期天
   C. 去
   D. 学校

12. Which sentence is in the right order for "We cut the cake"? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 蛋糕我们切。
   C. 蛋糕切我们。
   D. 切我们蛋糕。

13. Which word is pronounced xiāngjiāo? (1 mark)
   A. 香蕉
   B. 牛奶
   C. 蔬菜
   D. 米饭

14. Which Chinese word means "knee"? (1 mark)
   A. 膝盖 xīgài
   B. 脚 jiǎo
   C. 耳朵 ěrduo
   D. 刷牙 shuāyá

15. Which sentence means "The weather is very good today."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 今天有云。
   C. 今天天气很好。
   D. 今天下雨。

16. Read the pinyin: huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The garden is on the right of the house.
   B. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. Where is the sofa?

17. What does 你 (nǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I, me
   B. Classmates
   C. You
   D. And you? (a question word)

18. What does 有 (yǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To have, there is
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Older sister
   D. Father

19. Read the pinyin: diànshì zài kètīng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The television is in the living room.
   B. The garden is on the right of the house.
   C. The door is on the left.
   D. The bed is in the bedroom.

20. How many strokes does 上 have? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 3

21. Which word completes 卧室里有____? (There is a bed in the bedroom.) (1 mark)
   A. 床
   B. 桌子
   C. 花园
   D. 冰箱

22. What is the apostrophe for in xīngqī'èr? (1 mark)
   A. To separate the syllables qī and èr
   B. To show a tone
   C. To show a question
   D. To show a capital

23. Which sentence means "We cut the cake."? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 祝你生日快乐!
   C. 你生日是几月几号?
   D. 我们唱歌。

24. What does 肉 (ròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Meat
   B. Biscuits
   C. Banana
   D. Grapes

25. Fill the blank: 我早饭____饼。 (For breakfast I eat bǐng.) (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 去
   C. 是
   D. 喝

26. What does 牙 (yá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tooth
   B. Shoulder
   C. To touch
   D. To look, to see

27. What does 错 cuò mean in a true-or-false exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Today
   B. Rain
   C. Wrong
   D. Right

28. How does too much rain harm the environment? (1 mark)
   A. It makes the sun brighter
   B. It makes the soil drier
   C. It always makes the wind stronger
   D. It can cause floods

29. Read the pinyin: jīntiān yǒu yún. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is very big.
   B. The weather is very good today.
   C. Today there are clouds.
   D. The rain is heavy.

30. Which Chinese word means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. 花园 huāyuán
   B. 桌子 zhuōzi
   C. 下 xià
   D. 房子 fángzi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write two strategies for speaking Chinese clearly. (3 marks)

32. Give two habits of an active listener. (2 marks)

33. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

34. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 送 and 床. (2 marks)

35. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 菠菜 and 下面. (2 marks)

36. Write the numbers 1 to 5 in Chinese characters. (2 marks)

37. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喜欢 and 哪儿. (2 marks)

38. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 小 and 哥哥. (2 marks)

39. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 吃 and 前面. (2 marks)

40. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to eat bananas." (3 marks)

41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my ears to hear." (2 marks)

42. Break the syllables hǎo, jiào and nǐ into initial and final. (3 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肩膀, 切 and 去. (3 marks)

44. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 九 and 号. (2 marks)

45. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." and "The bathroom is beside the garden." (4 marks)

46. Write a short conversation of three lines in which two learners greet each other, give their names and ask "And you?". Include pinyin. (5 marks)

47. Rearrange and translate: 休息 / 星期六 / 在家 / 我. (3 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 左边 and 房间. (2 marks)

49. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 礼物 and 冰箱. (2 marks)

50. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 旁边 and 您好. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — mama
   Mama means mother in both languages.

2. A — Six
   六 (liù) means six.

3. C — Three
   三 (sān) means three.

4. B — Fruit (as a group)
   水果 (shuǐguǒ) means fruit (as a group).

5. B — Coffee
   咖啡 (kāfēi) means coffee.

6. B — The eyes see
   眼睛 is eyes and 看 is to see.

7. D — Stay away from fast rivers
   Floods are dangerous and fast rivers are unsafe.

8. A — 。
   The Chinese full stop is a small circle.

9. B — 谢谢!
   谢谢! (xièxie!) means "Thank you!".

10. B — Older sister
   姐姐 (jiějie) means older sister.

11. B — 星期天
   星期天 is pronounced xīngqītiān and means Sunday.

12. A — 我们切蛋糕。
   The order is who, action, thing.

13. A — 香蕉
   香蕉 is pronounced xiāngjiāo and means banana.

14. A — 膝盖 xīgài
   膝盖 (xīgài) means knee.

15. C — 今天天气很好。
   今天天气很好。 (jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.) means "The weather is very good today.".

16. A — The garden is on the right of the house.
   huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian. is 花园在房子右边。, which means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

17. C — You
   你 (nǐ) means you.

18. A — To have, there is
   有 (yǒu) means to have, there is.

19. A — The television is in the living room.
   diànshì zài kètīng. is 电视在客厅。, which means "The television is in the living room.".

20. D — 3
   上 has three strokes.

21. A — 床
   A bed belongs in the bedroom.

22. A — To separate the syllables qī and èr
   It marks where èr begins.

23. A — 我们切蛋糕。
   我们切蛋糕。 (wǒmen qiē dàngāo.) means "We cut the cake.".

24. A — Meat
   肉 (ròu) means meat.

25. A — 吃
   饼 is food, so 吃.

26. A — Tooth
   牙 (yá) means tooth.

27. C — Wrong
   错 is wrong; 对 is right.

28. D — It can cause floods
   Heavy rain causes floods.

29. C — Today there are clouds.
   jīntiān yǒu yún. is 今天有云。, which means "Today there are clouds.".

30. A — 花园 huāyuán
   花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen first and copy the tone with your hand; say it slowly then faster; record yourself and compare.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each strategy, 1 mark for explaining how it helps.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Face the speaker and stay quiet; listen for key words; nod or show you are following.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: 送: sòng, to give (a gift). 床: chuáng, bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 菠菜: bōcài, spinach. 下面: xiàmiàn, below.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 一, 二, 三, 四, 五.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all five correct, 1 mark for three or four.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喜欢: xǐhuan, to like. 哪儿: nǎr, where.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: 小: xiǎo, small. 哥哥: gēge, older brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吃: chī, to eat. 前面: qiánmiàn, in front of.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢吃香蕉。 wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: hǎo = h + ao; jiào = j + iao; nǐ = n + i.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct syllable.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肩膀: jiānbǎng, shoulder. 切: qiē, to cut. 去: qù, to go.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 九: jiǔ, nine. 号: hào, date (day of the month).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好!我叫安娜。你呢? nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Ānnà. nǐ ne? A: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct greeting line and 1 mark each for the name sentences, 1 mark for correct pinyin tone marks, 5 in total.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 On Saturday I rest at home.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 左边: zuǒbian, left side. 房间: fángjiān, room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 礼物: lǐwù, gift. 冰箱: bīngxiāng, fridge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 旁边: pángbiān, beside. 您好: nín hǎo, hello (polite).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
